mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0 in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1250) and industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signal contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1250 and INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 2.5%), a federal funds rate decline signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll increase exceeding 100,000 persons signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1250 thousand units in the prior month signals contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS < 500000) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5) signal weak consumer demand and accommodative policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 500000 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105 in the prior month signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105.
